## 6. Limitations

To be finalised with the results, but already known:

- Clinical test set is ~45 patients; all metrics carry wide confidence intervals.
- ChestX-ray14 labels are NLP-mined and roughly 10% noisy.
- Saliency and Grad-CAM show where a model looked, not why it decided. They are
  plausibility checks, not evidence of medical reasoning.
- No external or Indian-population validation.
- Negative subsampling changes the X-ray prevalence, so emitted probabilities are
  conditioned on the sampled prior.
